title: Identity-Aware Recurrent Text Classifier
summary: Comments are lowercased and regex-tokenized; a vocabulary of the 120,000 most frequent training tokens is built, with unknown and padding IDs. Sequences are head-truncated to 220 tokens. Embeddings are initialized by skip-gram word2vec trained on training text using negative sampling, frequency-based subsampling, and a linearly decayed Adam learning rate. The classifier applies embedding spatial dropout, a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU, then masked max and mean pooling from both recurrent outputs. Concatenated pooled features pass through a residual ReLU/dropout dense block and produce one toxicity logit plus identity logits. Training uses weighted binary cross-entropy for toxicity and unweighted auxiliary binary cross-entropy for identity labels. Weights upweight identity-containing examples and identity/toxicity mismatch groups, then are mean-normalized. AdamW uses epochwise learning-rate decay, mixed precision, and gradient clipping. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. Inference sigmoid-transforms toxicity logits and averages validation predictions from the final two epochs.
